assignments.value: GLOW MEDSPA — SERVICES, PRICING & POLICIES KNOWLEDGE BASE  IMPORTANT NOTE: All information below is general guidance only. It is not medical advice. Any medical questions, health concerns, contraindications, or safety questions must be directed to the provider during an in-person consultation.  === SERVICES OFFERED ===  BOTOX CONSULTATION Description: Botox is a treatment that temporarily relaxes facial muscles to soften fine lines and wrinkles such as forehead lines, frown lines, and crow's feet. Price: INR 12,000. Typical appointment duration: 30 minutes. Numbing / anesthesia: A topical numbing cream is available on request; local anesthesia is generally not required as the needles are very fine. Consultation: Required before a first Botox treatment.  DERMAL FILLERS Description: Dermal fillers add volume and smooth deeper lines, commonly used for lips, cheeks, and nasolabial folds. Price: INR 18,000. Typical appointment duration: 45 minutes. Numbing / anesthesia: Topical numbing cream is applied before treatment; many fillers also contain a local anesthetic (lidocaine) for comfort. Consultation: Required before dermal filler treatment.  HYDRAFACIAL Description: HydraFacial is a multi-step facial that cleanses, exfoliates, extracts, and hydrates the skin for an immediate glow. Price: INR 3,500. Typical appointment duration: 60 minutes. Numbing / anesthesia: No numbing cream or anesthesia is needed; the treatment is non-invasive and comfortable. Consultation: Not required; a quick skin assessment is done at the start of the appointment.  LASER HAIR REMOVAL Description: Laser hair removal uses targeted light to reduce unwanted hair over a course of sessions. Price: INR 5,000 per session. Typical appointment duration: 45 minutes. Numbing / anesthesia: A topical numbing cream can be applied for sensitive areas; most clients do not require it. Consultation: Required before the first laser session.  CHEMICAL PEEL Description: Chemical peels use a solution to exfoliate the skin and improve tone, texture, and mild pigmentation. Price: INR 4,500. Typical appointment duration: 45 minutes. Numbing / anesthesia: No numbing is typically needed; a mild tingling sensation is normal during the peel. Consultation: Not required for this treatment.  MICRONEEDLING Description: Microneedling creates tiny controlled micro-injuries to stimulate collagen, helping with texture, scars, and fine lines. Price: INR 6,500. Typical appointment duration: 60 minutes. Numbing / anesthesia: A topical numbing cream is applied about 20 to 30 minutes before the treatment for comfort. Consultation: Required before microneedling.  === GENERAL AFTERCARE GUIDANCE (non-medical) === These are general comfort tips, not medical instructions. For anything specific to your health, ask the provider. - Avoid strenuous exercise for about 24 hours after injectable and microneedling treatments. - Avoid direct sun exposure and use sunscreen after facials, peels, laser, and microneedling. - Avoid touching or massaging the treated area for the first several hours after Botox or fillers. - Stay hydrated and avoid very hot showers, saunas, or steam rooms for the first 24 hours after most treatments. - Avoid makeup for the recommended period after microneedling and peels. - Mild redness or swelling can be normal for a short time; if you have any concern, contact the clinic and speak with the provider.  === CONSULTATIONS === A consultation with the provider is required before first-time injectable treatments (Botox, dermal fillers), microneedling, and before laser hair removal (which also needs a patch test). HydraFacial and chemical peels do not require a separate consultation.  === BUSINESS HOURS === Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Saturday: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Sunday: Closed.  === CANCELLATION POLICY === We kindly ask for at least 24 hours notice to cancel or reschedule an appointment. Cancellations with less than 24 hours notice, or no-shows, may be subject to a cancellation fee. To cancel or reschedule, please call the clinic during business hours.  === MEDICAL DISCLAIMER === This knowledge base provides general information about services, pricing, and policies only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, contraindication guidance, or safety guarantees. Suitability for any treatment depends on your individual health and must be assessed by the provider. Please book a consultation for any medical questions or concerns.
